changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship')) BEGIN create table api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null,
SubjectUid uniqueidentifier null, Subject varchar(50) null, SubjectID int null,
ObjectUid uniqueidentifier null, Object varchar(50) null, ObjectID int null,
IntersectID int null, [Message] nvarchar(2500) null, Success bit null, IsNew bit null, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionRelationship] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, ItemNumber ASC ) ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_SubjectUid ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [SubjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_ObjectUid ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [ObjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Success ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [Success] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber ); END
changeSet.rollback: IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship')) BEGIN drop table api.ExecutionRelationship END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionField')) BEGIN create table api.ExecutionField ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null, FieldName nvarchar(250) not null, FieldValue nvarchar(max) null, FieldTypeID int null, LookupValue nvarchar(max) null, Ignore bit null CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, ItemNumber ASC, FieldName ASC ) ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionField_ItemNumber_Include ON api.ExecutionField ( ExecutionID DESC, ItemNumber ASC ) INCLUDE ( FieldTypeID ); END
changeSet.rollback: IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship')) BEGIN drop table api.ExecutionField END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.[ROUTINES] WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'relation' AND SPECIFIC_NAME = 'BulkUpsert')) BEGIN drop procedure [relation].[BulkUpsert] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('api.Execution', 'ErrorMessage') IS NULL BEGIN alter table api.Execution add ErrorMessage nvarchar(max) END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('api.Execution', 'ErrorMessage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN alter table api.Execution drop column ErrorMessage END
